raw_segments.text: Sin, Ivan suddenly got up from the table. I seem to be delirious. I am delirious in
fact talk any nonsense you like, I don't care. You won't drive me to fury as you
did last time, but I feel somehow ashamed. I want to walk about the room. I sometimes
don't see you and don't even hear your voice as I did last time, but I always guess
what you are praying, for it's I, I myself speaking, not you. Only I don't know whether
I was dreaming last time or whether I really saw you.
I'll wet a towel and put it on my head and perhaps you'll vanish into air.
